dimension_description: Quality-adjusted life years compress length of life and quality of life into one metric. This is a powerful but highly model-dependent quantity, so each item should state whether it is a stock of healthy time, a gain from an intervention, or a loss from disability. It is useful here because it gives a common pedagogical axis for many health choices.
